She served our country for 20 years and was a beloved member of her community.

She will never be forgotten.

We need rules of the road to keep our kids safe.

Today they announced they are doing just that. This is good for American consumers and farmers.

Next, we must pass my bipartisan bill to permanently allow year round E15.
